learning_outcomes.text: They know manufacturing-appropriate design rules and can apply them to practical examples.
They know mechanical equivalent diagrams and can analyze application cases, as well as determine and evaluate the appropriate mechanical equivalent diagram.
They know the common procedures of the FKM guideline for general strength calculation on cross-sections.
They know common procedures for calculating connections and fasteners and can apply them.
They know the application possibilities and strength calculation methods for separable and non-separable connections as well as for rotary motion elements.
They know friction-locked and form-fit drive elements as well as mechatronic elements of drive technology.
They have a fundamental understanding of constructive problem solutions.
They can independently implement knowledge about machine elements and drives and apply it to practical tasks.
They can transfer the acquired knowledge to different types of tasks.
They can develop constructive designs for a given problem and present them in the form of clear and meaningful hand sketches.
They can analyze constructive designs, identify critical areas, and create suitable strength proofs for the machine elements used.
They can design complex 3D CAD assembly drawings and derive fully dimensioned manufacturing drawings from them.
They can logically and comprehensibly document calculation procedures performed.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the field of machine elements
Fundamental remarks on the design process
assessment_rules: The module grade is based on the evaluated project, which accounts for 100% of the grade.
